The '''Y'Trella system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Sarin sector/Legends|Sarin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Y'Trella]].
